bio.text: Rhett Marques is a Republican candidate for U.S. House in Alabama in 2026 and a member of the Alabama House of Representatives (District 91).
He was first elected to the state House in 2018, succeeding Barry Moore, and represents Coffee County.
He grew up in Spanish Fort in Baldwin County, graduated from Fairhope High School, and owns Goodson Tire & Auto in Enterprise.
According to the Yellowhammer News report, he lives in the Wiregrass region, and he and his wife Christina have two daughters.
